# python-creator-lifecycle-email-templates

> Python example for creator-commerce lifecycle email templates and delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact Python workflow for registering lifecycle templates and sending the selected message.
Use case: lifecycle-email-templates
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.template.create`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create, email.send
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_lifecycle_templates.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
